title: Claudian settings path migrated to .claudian/
summary: .claudian/claudian-settings.json is current; .claude/claudian-settings.json is legacy. Docs only document the legacy path.

title: Complete claudian-settings.json schema + defaults
summary: Full ClaudianSettings interface (identity/security, model/thinking, content, environment, UI, i18n, providerConfigs, provider selection projections, lifecycle, collab, hidden commands) with DEFAULT_CLAUDIAN_SETTINGS defaults.

title: Claudian deletes .claude/mcp.json (does not write it)
summary: deleteLegacyMcpConfig() removes .claude/mcp.json at startup; MCP is wired via ACP sessions with mcpServers:[]. CONTRADICTS shipped docs.

title: Claudian writes .claude/settings.json only for permissions + plugin enablement
summary: CCSettingsStorage.save() merges into existing .claude/settings.json preserving unknown fields; sets $schema, permissions (allow/deny/ask/defaultMode/additionalDirectories), enabledPlugins.

title: Slash command schema + reversible ID encoding
summary: .claude/commands/<safeName>.md with frontmatter name/description/argument-hint/allowed-tools/model/disable-model-invocation/user-invocable/context/agent/hooks; IDs encode dashes->'-_' slashes->'--' prefixed cmd-.

title: Skill schema + validation
summary: .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; frontmatter requires string name (must equal folder) + string description; name lowercase-hyphen <=64 chars non-YAML-reserved; description <=1024; body non-empty.

title: Five providers with per-provider opaque config bags
summary: claude(default)/codex/grok/opencode/pi seeded into providerConfigs; per-provider defaults differ (documented).
